shopFiniteness.domain: Nonnegative exact integer currencies/keys/experience; numeric operations remain in the exact integer range. No edited/infinite resources.
shopFiniteness.argument: Buying keys preserves P and lowers money; selling keys lowers P by 3/15/30. Gold and experience upgrades lower P. Since 0<=money<=P, each smaller P block has rank strictly below the current block. Every resource-changing shop transaction strictly decreases the nonnegative integer R. Identity failure/exit/navigation steps are collapsed. Thus shop-only resource-changing cycles and infinite sequences are impossible for a finite initial budget.
shopFiniteness.coarseSuccessfulTransactionBound: R(initial), when there is no external reward input. A whole-game bound additionally requires finite, once-only external rewards; not established here.
